+from functools import cache
+from functools import wraps
+from typing import Awaitable
+from typing import Callable

+import pytest
+from fastapi import Depends
+from fastapi import FastAPI
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+from httpx import AsyncClient
+
+P = ParamSpec('P')
+T = TypeVar('T')
+
+class Reawaitable(Generic[T]):
+    __sentinel = object()
+    def __init__(self, awaitable: Awaitable[T]) -> None:
+        self.awaitable = awaitable
+        self.result = self.__sentinel
+    def __await__(self) -> Iterator[T]:
+        if self.result is self.__sentinel:
+            self.result = yield from self.awaitable.__await__()
+        return self.result
+
+def reawaitable(func: Callable[P, Awaitable[T]]) -> Callable[P, Reawaitable[T]]:
+    @wraps(func)
+    def wrapper(*args: P.args, **kwargs: P.kwargs) -> Reawaitable[T]:
+        return Reawaitable(func(*args, **kwargs))
+    return wrapper
+

+    foo: str = 'bar'
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+@cache
+@reawaitable
+async def get_settings() -> Settings:
+    return Settings()
+
+@app.get('/foo')
+async def foo(settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings)) -> str:
+    return settings.foo
+

+from rich.markup import render, escape
+
+def test_trailing_backslash_escape():
+    # Case 1: Single trailing backslash
+    text = r"Trailing \"
+    escaped = escape(text)
+    # If we just escape it, it's "Trailing \"
+    # If we then put it in front of a tag, it will escape the tag.
+    result = render(f"{escaped}[bold]Bold[/bold]")
+    # We want it to be "Trailing \Bold" (with Bold being styled)
+    # If it's escaped as "Trailing \\", then render("Trailing \\[bold]Bold[/bold]")

+    print(f"Input: {text!r} -> Escaped: {escaped!r} -> Rendered: {result}")
+    assert str(result).startswith("Trailing \\")
+
+    # Case 2: Even trailing backslashes
+    text = r"Trailing \\"
+    escaped = escape(text)
+    result = render(f"{escaped}[bold]Bold[/bold]")
+    print(f"Input: {text!r} -> Escaped: {escaped!r} -> Rendered: {result}")
+    assert str(result).startswith("Trailing \\")
+
+    # Case 3: Odd trailing backslashes (3)
+    text = r"Trailing \\\"
+    escaped = escape(text)
+    result = render(f"{escaped}[bold]Bold[/bold]")
+    print(f"Input: {text!r} -> Escaped: {escaped!r} -> Rendered: {result}")
+    assert str(result).startswith("Trailing \\\\")
+
